workshoptitle: Deploy and Use an Advanced OKE Cluster with Terraform Modules

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Workshop scope, objectives, prerequisites, and architecture.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to OCI before starting the workshop.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Deploy OKE with Simple Terraform Modules
tutorials.description: Use either Terraform CLI or OCI Resource Manager to deploy, verify, and remove a simple OKE environment.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Deploy OKE with Advanced Terraform Modules
tutorials.description: Use either Terraform CLI or OCI Resource Manager to deploy and operate an advanced OKE module design.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Demonstrate Key OKE Capabilities
tutorials.description: Apply reusable modules, compartment separation, node cycling, availability, and node-pool practices.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving help.
